title: Configure cargo-nextest for faster parallel test runs
description:
Add .config/nextest.toml configuring cargo-nextest: test thread count (num_cpus), test timeout per test (60s), retries for flaky tests (0 by default), junit XML output for CI. Add nextest to the CI workflow as the primary test runner. Artifact: .config/nextest.toml, CI workflow updated.

Acceptance: `cargo nextest run --workspace` runs all tests; test results appear in junit XML; flaky test threshold documented; CI uses nextest
